description: Drive straight 2 m, then drive into the door on the LEFT and stop in it, facing the way through. The 2 m straight is also what lets the door detector confirm the door (confirmation wants pose spread along the approach). The door is picked ONCE, when the second move starts: the nearest STRONG confirmed door on the left of the car's heading at that moment (side_of: positive relative bearing). It is held for the rest of the move, never re-picked. A door on the left that is already behind the car still counts as left, and the car turns back to it. Needs a door detector publishing /perception/doors_semantic and the global EKF. If no left door is found within 5 s of the second move starting, the move fails door_not_found and the mission aborts. Entry is the same as enter_nearest_door: a pre-point back on the door's own axis (clamp(1.3 R_min, 0.8, 1.6) m, 1.24 m on this car), then straight down that axis. Entered means within 0.15 m along the axis, within 0.05 m sideways of it, and within 10 deg of it.
